fullPassage: In the second half of the nineteenth century, Europe turned its eyes toward Africa. Colonial expansion in Africa is one example (China was another) of European imperialism in the nineteenth century. These European imperialists needed colonies for trade and raw materials for their new factories built during the Industrial Revolution. They also needed new markets in which to sell their manufactured goods. Their crowded populations needed new territory to overflow into. On the other hand, some Europeans hoped to help Africa and brought many gifts to them: written languages, new technology, trade, and Western learning. Africa, with its untouched mineral and agricultural resources, presented a valuable source of materials, offered opportunities for new markets, and provided new frontiers for adventurous colonists.

det.korean: raw materials(원자재) — 산업 혁명 이후 공장을 위한 원자재가 필요했다
det.analysis:
✅ ④ raw materials(원자재) — 새 공장에 필요한 것은 원자재
❌ ① written languages(문자 언어) — 유럽인이 아프리카에 가져다준 것이지 공장에 필요한 것이 아님
❌ ② manufactured goods(제조품) — 원자재로 만드는 결과물이지, 공장에 투입하는 것이 아님
❌ ③ mineral resources(광물 자원) — 아프리카의 자원이지 유럽 공장이 필요로 한 일반 원자재가 아님
det.tip: needed colonies for trade and _____ for their new factories → raw materials

questions.passage: In the second half of the nineteenth century, Europe turned its eyes toward Africa. Colonial expansion in Africa is one example (China was another) of European imperialism in the nineteenth century. These European imperialists needed colonies for trade and raw materials for their new factories built during the Industrial Revolution. They also needed new markets in which to sell their manufactured goods. Their crowded populations needed new territory to overflow into. On the other hand, some Europeans hoped to help Africa and brought many gifts to them: written languages, new technology, trade, and Western learning. Africa, with its untouched mineral and agricultural resources, presented __________ of materials, offered opportunities for new markets, and provided new frontiers for adventurous colonists.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: a valuable source(가치 있는 원천) — 아프리카의 미개발 자원이 가치 있는 원천이 되었다
det.analysis:
✅ ③ a valuable source(가치 있는 원천) — 미개발 광물·농업 자원이 가치 있는 자료 원천을 제공
❌ ① a minor portion(소량) — 아프리카 자원의 규모를 과소평가하는 표현
❌ ② an equal share(동등한 몫) — 식민지 맥락에서 '동등'은 부적합
❌ ④ a limited supply(한정된 공급) — 풍부한 자원을 설명하는 문맥과 모순
det.tip: Africa ... presented _____ of materials → a valuable source
